Title: Azure Monitor for containers agent (ciprod08072020) update

Body.Content:
Azure monitor for containers starting agent version ciprod08072020  will support following new features & fixes

  • You can now monitor status of your deployments & Horizontal Pod Autoscaler(HPA) including custom HPA, through workbook gallery. Learn more.
  • Health(tab) will now only be accessed through limited preview. Learn more to register for the limited preview.
  • Bug fixes such as showing node 'not ready' status correctly.
